review_candidates.title: Machine Learning Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: At Numrah , we build intelligent, modern applications that combine cutting-edge engineering with practical machine learning. We're looking for a Machine Learning Engineer who is deeply grounded in ML theory and excited to design, train, fine-tune, and deploy Large Language Models (LLMs) and other ML systems in real-world production environments. You’ll work closely with backend and product individuals/teams to deliver smart, scalable features—from rapid experimentation to full-scale deployment.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: If you’re passionate about ML theory, hands-on with LLMs, and know how to ship high-impact AI features, this role is for you.
